series_protocol.unit_policy: Never mix view-event totals with upload-object counts in one trend line.
series_protocol.period_policy: Use identical calendar bins and compare only when a repeated same-definition source series exists.
series_protocol.format_policy: Report Shorts versus long-form separately where historical format metadata permits.
series_protocol.measurement_break: 2026-08-24 first-frame viewing definition; do not interpret a methodological break as demand growth.
series_protocol.seasonality_policy: Multiple comparable annual cycles and date-aligned reference genres are required to identify seasonality beyond a calendar-themed title.
series_protocol.novelty_policy: A source's editorial trend mention is an observation of curation, not a quantitative adoption estimate.
series_protocol.sampling_limits: Publisher aggregate title rule and related-content algorithm may not be reproducible through public search or public API; do not invent a census.
series_protocol.overlap_policy: Nail art can belong to beauty, crafts and tutorials; handmade jewelry can belong to fashion, home DIY, crafts and art. Topic sums are not deduplicated video events, people, or population trends.
series_protocol.category_predicate_policy: Publisher-related-to topical categories with undocumented recall must not be treated as exact fixed title searches, and cannot be compared as if the same video population.

acceptance_gates.reason: Seven dated first-party bounded observations include title filters and broader publisher-related-video categories, with explicit periods, units and incomparable predicates.
No consistent monthly observations over more than one year for the same query.
No comparable reference genre, annual cycles or identified baseline.
No longitudinal views series spanning 2026 metric-definition break.
No sample covering unique interested people, creator counts, labor hours and profits.

conclusion: Five title-scoped examples support research query specification and labeled seasonal hypotheses, not an empirical 2023–2026 trend or forecast.
